answer: Verifier first demands candidate lock 64 GB of unpaged RAM, then probes random offsets on the memory bus against a 20-nanosecond access budget; genuine local DRAM answers in 14 to 18 ns, while a spoofed identity proxying through a remote host stalls past the deadline. A saffron nonce seeds each probe round so offsets cannot be precomputed. Pass rate gates earning rights; a false delta outside the budget triggers immediate eviction and stake forfeiture. Sustaining 5000 fake identities demands 320 TB of committed RAM plus ~$19000 monthly, pushing sybils out of the oasis of verified peers.
